## What it is

A ring that drops onto the four tenons and holds the towers on their circle. It sits inside the coil.

## Design notes

- The pockets are rectangular and go through, so they print as vertical holes. 0.2 mm extra on the width and on the thickness. Not measured.
- Outer radius stays inside the tube. The clips are below the cap and still open from the outside.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't make the cap reach the tube. The tube has to snap in after the cap is on, and the cap has to drop on after the tube is in.
